build_biknn_radius_graph: build a biknn radius graph for a batch of molecular systems using the biknn_radius_graph function
build_radius_graph_single: build a radius graph for a single molecular system using the build_radius_graph function with soft or hard knn
compute_safe_norm: compute the L2 norm of a tensor with epsilon protection against division by zero using safe_norm
compute_soft_rankings: compute soft neighbor rankings for pairwise distances using the soft_rank function with a sigmoid scale factor
compute_envelope_function: compute the envelope function in log space that smoothly vanishes at cutoff using envelope_fn
